electrical_characteristics.signal_swing: 3.3V logic levels (compatible with RP2040 USB PHY)

design_rationale.series_resistors: 33Ω series termination on both D+ and D- for USB impedance matching and signal integrity. RP2040 datasheet specifies 27Ω nominal, 22-33Ω acceptable range. Using 33Ω due to JLCPCB part availability.
design_rationale.esd_protection: USBLC6-4SC6 provides bi-directional ESD clamping on USB data lines. Protects both RP2040 USB PHY and USB connector from electrostatic discharge. Clamps to VCC (3.3V) rail.
design_rationale.usb_vdd_decoupling: 100nF ceramic capacitor per RP2040 datasheet requirement. Dedicated USB PHY power domain requires local decoupling within 5mm of pin.
design_rationale.shield_grounding: Ferrite bead (600Ω @ 100MHz) + 1MΩ resistor in parallel. Provides high-frequency common-mode noise filtering while allowing DC discharge path. Prevents ground loops.
design_rationale.connector_choice: USB Type-C for modern standard, reversible insertion, and better mechanical durability compared to Micro USB.
